On this website

Typefaces

Four families are served from this site itself, so no request leaves for a font service and no visitor address reaches one. Serving them here means redistributing them, so each one keeps its own licence and its own copyright notice. Both are the SIL Open Font License 1.1; the copyright holders differ.
